name: Nirmo
source:
"Nihahahaha, you're such a pervert, Hero ☆ What kind of massage were you imagining?"

A bright and positive girl. She won't lose heart nor hope over trifle matters. The type that can make life fun, including naughty things. In general she can handle all sorts of housework, but for some reason only her cooking leaves a lot to be desired.

To Nirmo, [url=/c81262]Earl[/url] is like a father and a partner.
